title: Low-Altitude ISAC with Rotatable Active and Passive Arrays
release_scope: independent reduced-size paper-model reproduction with explicitly different projected-ascent AO subsolvers; not all figures or original Algorithm1-4

equations.scope: Euler RxRyRz, actual rotated coordinates, one-sided directivity and analytic Jacobians
geometry multipath direct and reflected communication/sensing channels; Eq12b Hermitian bridge convention used literally
dedicated sensing beams interfere with data, actual beampattern, normalized NMSE, exact scaling, weighted utility and hardware constraints
outer fixed-iota AO; analytic gradient Armijo projection under angle box constraints

disclosures: Deterministic two-user, 2x2 BS and 2x2 RIS, six-look normalized fixture differs from published figure scenes and 100-realization averages.
The precoder block uses analytic projected gradient ascent on the power ball, not the paper's QT/MM QCQP update.
The RIS phase block uses analytic phase-gradient ascent, not Riemannian conjugate gradient.
Angle updates use analytic Euler Jacobians and Armijo box projection, without the paper's Barzilai-Borwein initialization.
RIS begins with Rx(pi) to make its one-sided reflecting face visible to reciprocal BR directions; limits are centered on this initial frame.
Eq12b is used with its stated Hermitian outer-product bridge. No undocumented reciprocal-transpose convention correction is applied.
No QT/MM or RCG reproduction claim, global-optimum claim, exhaustive trade-off frontier, or full published sweep is made.
